description: This Java class 'EncounterTypeEditor' extends a generic property editor to handle serialization and deserialization of 'EncounterType' objects within the OpenMRS framework. It provides methods to retrieve EncounterType instances by ID or UUID, facilitating the conversion of these objects for web form handling and other data transport mechanisms.

classes.name: EncounterTypeEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing/deserializing EncounterType objects, allowing integration with Spring framework for web forms and data processing.

methods.name: EncounterTypeEditor
methods.description: Default constructor for the EncounterTypeEditor class.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType object by its integer ID via the EncounterService.

methods.description: Retrieves an EncounterType object by its UUID string via the EncounterService.
